name: Saveria Colosimo

events.title: Baptism
events.description: Daughter of Raffaele Colosimo and Filippina Iera

bioAdditions: Saveria was baptized on 26 October 1848, daughter of Raffaele Colosimo and Filippina Iera (S1). The tree's 25 October is probably her birth date. She married Domenico Gabriele Fiorillo at San Mango on 1 April 1870 (S2). The parish burial index has Saveria Colosimo, widow of Domenico Fiorillo, buried 10 August 1931 with a stated age of 70 (S3). Husband and widowhood match (Domenico died 1921), but the age is about twelve years too low. This entry is a candidate for her death and conflicts with the tree's 26 May 1926.

conflicts.foundValue: Candidate: burial 10 Aug 1931, widow of Domenico Fiorillo (age given 70)
conflicts.assessment: Candidate only (age discrepancy). No Saveria Colosimo burial in 1926 in the index.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me). Baptism and marriage indexed.
